# Analysis configuration & data sources

This report was generated with _PCGR_ v`r pcg_report$settings$software$pcgr_version`, using the following key settings.

```{r settings_pdf_lists}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

conf <- pcg_report$settings$conf
sp <- conf$sample_properties
val <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x) | x %in% "NA")) "N/A" else
    paste(as.character(x), collapse = ", ")
}
on_off <- function(x) if (isTRUE(x)) "ON" else "OFF"
## value with its source (provided by the user, or estimated by PCGR)
with_source <- function(x, src) {
  if (val(x) == "N/A") return("N/A")
  if (val(src) == "N/A") val(x) else paste0(val(x), " (", src, ")")
}
## markdown bullet (level 1 or 2) with value in bold
item <- function(label, value, level = 1) {
  paste0(if (level == 2) "    - " else "- ", label, ": **",
         stringr::str_replace_all(val(value), "([*_])", "\\\\\\1"), "**")
}
heading <- function(x) c("", paste0("**", x, "**"), "")

gencode_meta <- pcg_report$settings$reference_data$source_metadata
gencode_version <- if (is.data.frame(gencode_meta)) {
  gencode_meta$source_version[gencode_meta$source_abbreviation == "gencode"]
} else NULL
transcript_set <- paste0(
  "GENCODE - ",
  if (isTRUE(as.logical(conf$vep$vep_gencode_basic)))
    "basic set" else "all transcripts",
  if (length(gencode_version) == 1) paste0(" (v", gencode_version, ")"))

left <- c(
  heading("General"),
  item("Genome assembly", pcg_report$settings$genome_assembly),
  item("Variant actionability guidelines", "AMP/ASCO/CAP"),
  item("Variant oncogenicity guidelines", "ClinGen/CGC/VICC"),
  item("Biomarker sources", pcgrr:::bm_db_label(pcg_report)),
  item("Tumor site", sp$site),
  item("Subject sex", conf$subject_properties$sex),
  item("Age at sampling (years)", conf$subject_properties$age))
right <- c()

if (isTRUE(pcg_report$content$snv_indel$eval)) {
  as_conf <- conf$somatic_snv$allelic_support
  tag_ok <- function(tag) !is.null(tag) && !identical(tag, "_NA_")
  allelic <- c(
    if (tag_ok(as_conf$tumor_dp_tag) && !is.null(as_conf$tumor_dp_min))
      item("Minimum sequencing depth (DP) tumor", as_conf$tumor_dp_min, 2),
    if (tag_ok(as_conf$tumor_af_tag) && !is.null(as_conf$tumor_af_min))
      item("Minimum allelic fraction (AF) tumor", as_conf$tumor_af_min, 2),
    if (tag_ok(as_conf$tumor_dp_tag) && tag_ok(as_conf$tumor_af_tag) &&
        !is.null(as_conf$tumor_ad_min))
      item("Minimum allelic depth (AD) tumor", as_conf$tumor_ad_min, 2),
    if (tag_ok(as_conf$control_dp_tag) && !is.null(as_conf$control_dp_min))
      item("Minimum sequencing depth (DP) control", as_conf$control_dp_min, 2),
    if (tag_ok(as_conf$control_af_tag) && !is.null(as_conf$control_af_max))
      item("Maximum allelic fraction (AF) control", as_conf$control_af_max, 2),
    if (tag_ok(as_conf$control_dp_tag) && tag_ok(as_conf$control_af_tag) &&
        !is.null(as_conf$control_ad_max))
      item("Maximum allelic depth (AD) control", as_conf$control_ad_max, 2))
  left <- c(
    left,
    heading("SNV/InDel settings"),
    item("Sequencing assay mode", conf$assay_properties$mode),
    item("Sequencing assay type", conf$assay_properties$type),
    item("Coding target size", paste0(
      val(conf$assay_properties$effective_target_size_mb), " Mb")),
    item("Show noncoding variants", as.logical(conf$other$show_noncoding)),
    item("MSI classifier (internal)", on_off(isTRUE(pcg_report$content$msi$eval) &&
                                    !isTRUE(pcg_report$content$msi$missing_data))),
    item("MSI caller (external)",
         if (isTRUE(pcg_report$content$msi$external$eval))
           pcgrr::msi_external_display(pcg_report$content$msi)$caller_label else "OFF"),
    item("Include germline findings",
         on_off(pcg_report$content$germline_classified$eval)),
    "- Variant Effect Predictor (VEP) settings",
    item("Transcript set", transcript_set, 2),
    item("Transcript pick order",
         stringr::str_replace_all(val(conf$vep$vep_pick_order), ",", ", "), 2),
    item("Regulatory regions annotation", as.logical(conf$vep$vep_regulatory), 2),
    item("Buffer size", conf$vep$vep_buffer_size, 2),
    item("Number of forks", conf$vep$vep_n_forks, 2),
    if (length(allelic) > 0) c("- Allelic support filtering (SNVs/InDels)", allelic),
    item("Mutational burden estimation", on_off(pcg_report$content$tmb$eval)),
    item("TMB algorithm", paste0("TMB_", val(conf$somatic_snv$tmb$tmb_display)), 2),
    item("TMB-high threshold", paste0(
      val(conf$somatic_snv$tmb$tmb_high_threshold), " mut/Mb"), 2))
  sig <- conf$somatic_snv$mutational_signatures
  right <- c(
    right,
    heading("SNV/InDel settings (continued)"),
    item("Mutational signatures estimation",
         on_off(pcg_report$content$mutational_signatures$eval)),
    item("Minimum number of mutations required", sig$mutation_limit, 2),
    item("All reference signatures", as.logical(sig$all_reference_signatures), 2),
    item("Inclusion of artefact signatures",
         as.logical(sig$include_artefact_signatures), 2),
    item("Minimum tumor-type prevalence (percent) of reference signatures",
         sig$prevalence_reference_signatures, 2))
}
if (isTRUE(pcg_report$content$cna$eval)) {
  cna <- conf$somatic_cna
  right <- c(
    right,
    heading("CNA settings"),
    item("CNA thresholding mode", cna$threshold_mode),
    item("Amplification threshold (absolute)", cna$amp_threshold_absolute),
    item("Amplification threshold (relative)", cna$amp_threshold_relative),
    item("Effective amplification threshold", cna$amp_threshold_effective),
    item("Gain threshold (absolute)", cna$gain_threshold_absolute),
    item("Gain threshold (relative)", cna$gain_threshold_relative),
    item("Heterozygous deletion threshold (absolute)", cna$del_threshold_absolute),
    item("Heterozygous deletion threshold (relative)", cna$del_threshold_relative),
    item("Tumor ploidy", with_source(sp$tumor_ploidy, sp$tumor_ploidy_source)),
    item("Tumor purity", with_source(sp$tumor_purity, sp$tumor_purity_source)),
    item("Genomic instability (HRD) score estimated",
         as.logical(cna$estimate_hrd)))
}
if (isTRUE(pcg_report$content$expression$eval)) {
  right <- c(
    right,
    heading("Expression settings"),
    item("RNA expression similarity analysis",
         on_off(as.logical(conf$expression$similarity_analysis))))
  sim_sources <- pcgrr::expression_similarity_sources(conf)
  if (length(sim_sources) > 0) {
    right <- c(right, item("Reference sources", sim_sources, level = 2))
  }
}
if (isTRUE(pcg_report$content$fusion$eval)) {
  right <- c(
    right,
    heading("RNA fusion settings"),
    item("Minimum split reads required", conf$rna_fusion$min_split_reads))
}

cat("```{=typst}\n#block(width: 100%, inset: (x: 10pt, y: 6pt), radius: 3pt, ",
    "stroke: (left: 3pt + pcgr-main), fill: pcgr-stripe)[\n",
    "#set text(size: 8pt)\n#set par(leading: 0.5em, justify: false)\n",
    "#set list(spacing: 0.5em)\n",
    "#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 1.6em)[\n```\n\n",
    paste(left, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\n```{=typst}\n][\n```\n\n",
    paste(right, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\n```{=typst}\n]\n]\n```\n\n", sep = "")
```

## Data sources and versions

```{r data_versions_pdf}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

## datasets as listed in the HTML report (Documentation), in two columns
## with a smaller font
ref_datasets <- pcg_report$settings$reference_data$source_metadata
if (is.data.frame(ref_datasets) && NROW(ref_datasets) > 0) {
  if ("wflow" %in% colnames(ref_datasets)) {
    ref_datasets <- ref_datasets[
      stringr::str_detect(ref_datasets$wflow, "pcgr"), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  ## sources registered with several source types are listed once (as in
  ## the HTML report)
  if ("source_type" %in% colnames(ref_datasets)) {
    st <- ref_datasets$source_type
    sa <- ref_datasets$source_abbreviation
    ref_datasets <- ref_datasets[
      !((sa == "dbnsfp" & st %in% "gene") |
          (sa == "depmap" & !st %in% "other") |
          (sa == "tcga_pancan_2018" & st %in% "phenotype")), , drop = FALSE]
  }

  ## markdown special characters in free text
  md_escape <- function(x) {
    stringr::str_replace_all(x, "([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>#@$])", "\\\\\\1")
  }
  entries <- vapply(seq_len(NROW(ref_datasets)), function(i) {
    d <- ref_datasets[i, ]
    name <- if (!is.na(d$source_url))
      paste0("[", md_escape(d$source), "](", d$source_url, ")") else
        md_escape(d$source)
    version <- if (!is.na(d$source_version))
      paste0(" (**", md_escape(d$source_version), "**)") else ""
    license <- if (is.na(d$source_license)) "" else {
      lic <- md_escape(d$source_license)
      if (!is.na(d$source_license_url))
        lic <- paste0("[", lic, "](", d$source_license_url, ")")
      paste0(" - ", lic)
    }
    paste0("- **", name, "**", version, " - ",
           md_escape(d$source_description), license)
  }, character(1))

  ## two balanced columns (split by text length)
  cum_len <- cumsum(nchar(entries))
  n_left <- max(1, which.min(abs(cum_len - cum_len[length(cum_len)] / 2)))
  col_left <- entries[seq_len(n_left)]
  col_right <- entries[-seq_len(n_left)]

  cat(
    "PCGR data bundle version: **",
    pcg_report$settings$reference_data$version, "**.\n\n",
    "```{=typst}\n#block[\n#set text(size: 7pt, hyphenate: false)\n",
    "#set par(leading: 0.45em, justify: false)\n",
    "#set list(spacing: 0.45em)\n",
    "#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 1.4em)[\n```\n\n",
    paste(col_left, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\n```{=typst}\n][\n```\n\n",
    paste(col_right, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\n```{=typst}\n]\n]\n```\n\n",
    sep = "")
} else {
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", 
    "Reference data source metadata not available.", title = "N/A"))
}
```
